name: Financial Assistance for Treatment of Chronic Diseases (HBOCWWB)
benefit: 1. Under this scheme, financial assistance up to ₹1,00,000/- is provided to registered workers for indoor treatment of chronic diseases like Cancer, TB, AIDS, etc.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be registered under the Haryana Building &amp; Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
   1. The registered worker must have a regular membership for one year.
   1. The workers who are registered and require indoor treatment for chronic diseases such as cancer, tuberculosis (TB), AIDS, etc., are eligible to apply under the scheme.
   1. The application frequency is limited to once.
